items.Sentence: The new WWTF at 2267 Ranchito Drive, La Grange consists of a headworks, magnetic flow meter, extended aeration basin, clarifier, chlorine contact basin, lined storage pond, four concrete sludge drying beds with decanting structures, and 40 acres of Use Area.
